Download Queensland SALI sites, reports and laboratory data

Source: R/sali.R
fetch_sali.Rd

Reads Queensland's Soil and Land Information system (SALI) from its public services and saves what they return in dir: the site layer (Queensland Spatial, MapServer layer 101, the sites with an Australian Soil Classification label and laboratory data, one JSON file per page in dir/layer), then for each site its report (the SALI4320 site listing report, a PDF, in dir/pdf/<PROJECT>_<SITE>.pdf) and its laboratory samples with their results from the SALI soil chemistry API (OData Samples with SiteLabMethodResults, in dir/lab/<PROJECT>_<SITE>_samples.json). read_sali_pedons reads the folder.

Usage

fetch_sali(
  dir,
  sites = NULL,
  cap_bytes = 150000,
  workers = 1L,
  pause = 1,
  max_sites = Inf,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

dir

Folder for the downloaded files (created when missing).

sites

Optional sites to download: a data frame with project_code and site_id, or a character vector of "<PROJECT>_<SITE>". By default every site of the layer whose label names an ASC order (the layer's "Unclassified" sites, which read_sali_pedons leaves out, are not downloaded).

cap_bytes

Largest report downloaded, in bytes (150 KB).

workers

Number of processes downloading at once (parallel::mclapply, each taking every workers-th site; always 1 on Windows).

pause

Seconds to wait after each request (in each process).

max_sites

Maximum number of sites downloaded in this call.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

Invisibly, a data frame of the sites selected: project_code, site_id, asc_label, stem, pdf ("ok", "oversize", "failed" or NA when not attempted in this call) and lab ("ok", "failed" or NA).

Details

Some reports embed full-size site photographs (one was over 50 MB): a report is downloaded only up to cap_bytes; a larger one is aborted as soon as it passes the cap, marked by a file <PROJECT>_<SITE>.pdf.oversize and not tried again. Files already in dir (and oversize marks) are not downloaded again, so an interrupted run can be resumed; a failed request is tried again on the next run. Each request waits pause seconds, retries with a growing backoff, and the run stops (an error) on any page that asks for a login, a key or the acceptance of terms, or that a web application firewall rejected. The report host began refusing requests after some 14,000 of them (2 processes, a 1 s pause), so fetch in batches (max_sites) rather than all at once. Requests go only to the layer of Queensland Spatial and, per site, to the report host and the soil chemistry API; the report address is built from the project code and site number, not taken from the data.

The data are licensed under CC BY 4.0; cite them as sali_citation says.

References

Queensland Government. Soil and Land Information (SALI). https://www.qld.gov.au/environment/land/soil/soil-data

See also

read_sali_pedons, benchmark_sali, sali_citation.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fetch_sali("sali", max_sites = 20)
peds <- read_sali_pedons("sali")
benchmark_sali(peds)
} # }
